fact_check_method: Every reference_answer/reference_claims value was checked against text extracted directly from the downloaded PDFs with pypdf (not through the app's ingestion pipeline, which is currently blocked on this machine - see datasets/README.md). This confirms factual accuracy of the source material, not retrieval or generation quality, and is not a substitute for the human review FR-EVAL-1 still requires.
notes: v0.2 adds 30 cases (029-058) explicitly tagged by the retrieval strategy they are intended to exercise (target-lexical, target-semantic, target-graph, target-hybrid), retrofits the same tags onto the original 28 cases, and fact-checks every case (old and new) against extracted PDF text. Still not validated against actual retrieval output end to end - see datasets/README.md for the ingestion blocker. reviewed_by records the fact-check pass, not independent human review.
